mapper.sql: id, platform_id, external_account_id, name, platform, account_type, status, schedulable, error_message, rate_limited_at, rate_limit_reset_at, overload_until, temp_unschedulable_until, temp_unschedulable_reason, concurrency, priority, rate_multiplier, last_used_at, bound_key_id, last_sample_at, backfill_until, last_sync_error, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pool_accounts ( platform_id, external_account_id, name, platform, account_type, status, schedulable, error_message, rate_limited_at, rate_limit_reset_at, overload_until, temp_unschedulable_until, temp_unschedulable_reason, concurrency, priority, rate_multiplier, last_used_at, bound_key_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{platformId}, #{externalAccountId}, #{name}, #{platform}, #{accountType}, #{status}, #{schedulable}, #{errorMessage}, #{rateLimitedAt}, #{rateLimitResetAt}, #{overloadUntil}, #{tempUnschedulableUntil}, #{tempUnschedulableReason}, #{concurrency}, #{priority}, #{rateMultiplier}, #{lastUsedAt}, #{boundKeyId}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, now()), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, now()) ) ON CONFLICT (platform_id, external_account_id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, platform = EXCLUDED.platform, account_type = EXCLUDED.account_type, status = EXCLUDED.status, schedulable = EXCLUDED.schedulable, error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message, rate_limited_at = EXCLUDED.rate_limited_at, rate_limit_reset_at = EXCLUDED.rate_limit_reset_at, overload_until = EXCLUDED.overload_until, temp_unschedulable_until = EXCLUDED.temp_unschedulable_until, temp_unschedulable_reason = EXCLUDED.temp_unschedulable_reason, concurrency = EXCLUDED.concurrency, priority = EXCLUDED.priority, rate_multiplier = EXCLUDED.rate_multiplier, last_used_at = EXCLUDED.last_used_at, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pool_accounts WHERE platform_id = #{platformId} ORDER BY external_account_id
